zh: 同一条对角线上的格子行号加列号相同，记为 d，d 从 0 取到 R+C−2，一共 R+C−1 条对角线，按 d 递增依次处理即可。
对第 d 条对角线，合法的行号范围是 max(0, d−C+1) 到 min(R−1, d)，列号就是 d 减行号；剩下只需决定这一段行号是正序还是倒序走。
d 为偶数时从左下走向右上，即行号从大到小；d 为奇数时从右上走向左下，即行号从小到大；按这个顺序依次取出元素，全部用空格连接输出。
en: Cells on the same diagonal share the same row-plus-column sum d, which runs from 0 to R+C-2, giving R+C-1 diagonals to handle in increasing order of d.
For diagonal d the valid rows run from max(0, d-C+1) to min(R-1, d), and the column is d minus the row; all that remains is deciding whether to walk those rows forward or backward.
For even d go from bottom-left to top-right, so rows decrease; for odd d go from top-right to bottom-left, so rows increase; collect the elements in this order and print them separated by spaces.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate the row-plus-column index sum d and determine the valid row index range for that diagonal. For even d iterate the row indices in reverse; for odd d iterate them forward.

## Why it is correct

Every cell belongs to exactly one diagonal d=i+j, and the valid row range guarantees no out-of-bounds access and complete coverage. Increasing d and alternating the row direction matches the given traversal rule exactly.

## Complexity

Time and output space O(RC).
